Translate "Ayer se estrenó la segunda parte de «Dune», la adaptación de Denis Villeneuve de la novela homónima de Frank Herbert. No son pocos los análisis cinematográficos de la obra que la han tildado de «izquierdista», de poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas «progresistas»" Every quoted phrase must be followed by an unquoted explanation.assistant

The second part of "Dune", the adaptation of Denis Villeneuve's novel of the same name by Frank Herbert, premiered yesterday. There are many film analyses of the work that have labeled it as "leftist" and have praised its special sensitivity towards "progressive" causes.

In this context, "izquierdista" refers to a political or ideological alignment that is often associated with left-wing or progressive views. In this case, the film's portrayal of a complex and nuanced world with a strong emphasis on social justice and environmentalism has led some critics to label it as "leftist".

On the other hand, "poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas 'progresistas'" means that the film has a special sensitivity towards progressive causes. This phrase is used to describe the film's portrayal of themes such as social inequality, environmental degradation, and the struggle for power and control, which are all common in progressive or left-wing ideologies.
